name: BETX
rootCause: The 600 million BETX tokens held by BETX managers were stolen by hacker and sold on the Newdex exchange. Preliminary analysis shows that the cause of this attack is that the private key of BETX project is stolen, and the hacker gains the owner privilege and transfers all the existing tokens of the contract. The selloff caused the BETX token to fluctuate sharply and close to zero.
